text.en: Title and Scope of the Decree. This Decree shall be known as the Barangay Day Care Center

That in every barangay with at least one hundred (100) family heads residing therein, there shall
be established a Day Care Center.

That said Day Care Center shall look after the nutritional needs and social and mental
development of all children from ages 2 to 5 when their parents are unable to do so.

That said Day Care Center should be staffed with at least one (1) female day care nursery worker
of good physical health who is competent to provide substitute parental care and to provide services for their
social and mental development.

That said Barangay Day Care Centers shall be accredited by the Bureau of Family and Child
Welfare of the DSSD.

That funds for the establishment and maintenance of depressed Barangay Day Care Centers may
be appropriated from the unexpended balance of local and national government or from public donations.

This decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 11th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and

seventy-eight.
